title: Better Auth admin user:update role can replace another account’s phone number
summary: When both admin and phone-number plugins are used, a non-full-admin role with user:update can set its own phone number on another account and mark it verified. The attacker can then use phone OTP to obtain that account’s session, including a more privileged account. Full-admin-only deployments are not affected.
ai_role: Discovered by Anthropic’s OSS Scanner, ANT-2026-938BEJ5J.
classification_note: The vulnerability is documented as a public disclosure; the source does not establish prior defender knowledge or exploitation.
remediation_note: Upgrade better-auth to 1.7.16 or 1.8.0-beta.5. Updates to phoneNumber or phoneNumberVerified now require user:set-phone; custom access-control roles must grant that permission where appropriate.

impacts.conditions: Both admin and phone-number plugins are enabled; a non-full-admin role has user:update; attacker can use phone OTP after changing the target number.
